mapper.insert: INSERT INTO content_moderation_logs ( target_type, target_id, user_id, trigger_source, rule_hits, target_excerpt, latency_ms, ai_decision, risk_level, categories, image_url, image_hash, evidence_json, confidence, reason, model_name, prompt_version, review_status ) VALUES ( #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{userId}, #{triggerSource}, #{ruleHits}, #{targetExcerpt}, #{latencyMs}, #{aiDecision}, #{riskLevel}, #{categories}, #{imageUrl}, #{imageHash}, #{evidenceJson}, #{confidence}, #{reason}, #{modelName}, #{promptVersion}, #{reviewStatus} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, target_type, target_id, trigger_source, rule_hits, target_excerpt, latency_ms, user_id, ai_decision, risk_level, categories, image_url, image_hash, evidence_json, confidence, reason, model_name, prompt_version, reviewer_id, review_status, reviewed_at, created_at FROM content_moderation_logs WHERE target_type = #{targetType} AND target_id = #{targetId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE content_moderation_logs SET reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, review_status = #{reviewStatus}, reviewed_at = NOW() WHERE target_type = #{targetType} AND target_id = #{targetId} AND review_status = 'pending'
